title: Geno Smith: Succeeding with the Jets would be like "a story in a movie"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Geno Smith: Succeeding with the Jets would be like "a story in a movie"
sources.description: Geno Smith's return to the Jets this offseason offers both the team and the player a second chance at the kind of success that eluded them the first time they were together.
